summary: The change invalidates in-flight roster loads on picker edits and ignores stale completions before applying server selection, with coverage for the relevant edit paths.

evidence: static/admin.js adds markProviderSelectionEdited and invokes it from bulk edits, checkbox changes, discard, and remove-missing actions.
static/admin.js checks the load generation before applying the roster and server selection, so an edit during the GET makes the completion stale.
tests/admin-models-catalog.test.ts adds a focused structural test covering the stale-load guard and picker edit handlers.
